tools.name: resolve_business
tools.description: Use when given a business domain or website and asked for that business's public ABIZ record or declared business facts. It performs the DNS TXT lookup (_abiz.<domain>) and the HTTPS fetch and validation for you, and returns the exact published record. Set verbose to true to also get checks, sources

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "resolve_business" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
